title: Kerala Lottery Result Today, October 9, 2025 Live: Karunya Plus KN-592 Bumper Winning Numbers | India News - News18
text: Kerala Lottery Result Today Live, 09-10-2025: The Kerala State Lottery Department will publish the Karunya Plus KN-592 Lottery results on Thursday, October 9. The draw is scheduled for around 3 p.m. at Gorky Bhavan near Bakery Junction in Thiruvananthapuram, and it will be overseen by independent judges. Participants are eligible to win substantial cash prizes, including a first prize of Rs 1 crore, a second prize of Rs 30 lakh, and a third prize of Rs 5 lakh. You may also save the entire list as a PDF for your records and future use. Participants can verify the Karunya Plus KN- 592 Lottery results at the Kerala Government Gazette office. The official list of winning numbers is also published on the Kerala Lottery website: keralalottery.info Winners must first verify their ticket number against the official results published in the Kerala Government Gazette. If the numbers match, they must proceed to the Kerala Lottery Office in Gorky Bhavan, near Bakery Junction in Thiruvananthapuram, to claim their prize. To claim your prize money, visit the lottery offices in Thiruvananthapuram within 30 days of the draw date. To claim your prize money, bring your winning ticket and any accompanying identification. The winner should submit the original ticket along with all the required documents to the concerned authority.
